title: Sep 29 Results + Sep 30 Preview: Three Wins and One Clunker—We'll Take It
summary: 75% hit rate on Sep 29, and we're doubling down on Atlanta tomorrow. Let's talk.

content.value:
## Let Me Be Honest: That Was Solid

Look, I'm not here to blow smoke—75% is a damn good day in this business. Three winners, one loser, and the loser was literally a coin flip at 50%. If you're complaining about going 3-1, you might want to check your expectations at the door.

## The Breakdown: Winners and Losers

The Braves delivered at 61% confidence—no surprise there. The Yankees took care of business at 56%, and the Padres absolutely crushed it at our highest confidence pick of 63%. The only blemish? The Astros at 50%, which was basically a toss-up anyway. If you bet heavy on a 50% pick, that's a you problem, not a model problem.

## The Hot Take: That Astros Loss Was Inevitable

Can we talk about the elephant in the room? A 50% pick is NOT a pick. It's the model shrugging its shoulders and saying 'good luck.' The fact that we went 3-1 instead of 4-0 because of a literal coin flip shouldn't bother anyone with a functioning brain. The three picks with actual conviction? Money in the bank.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: We're Going Back to the Well

Here's where it gets interesting—our top pick for Sep 30 is the EXACT same matchup that cashed for us yesterday. Phillies at Braves, and we're riding with Atlanta again at 61% confidence. You know what that tells me? The model sees something structural here, not just a one-day fluke.

## The Pitcher Matchup: Mahle's Home Cooking

Cristopher Sánchez takes the mound for Philly against Tyler Mahle for Atlanta. Let me be blunt: the Braves at home with Mahle on the bump against a Phillies squad that just lost this exact matchup yesterday? The model isn't being stubborn—it's being smart. Until the variables change, the pick stays the same.

## Bottom Line: Respect the Streak

We're 3-1, the confidence picks hit at 100%, and tomorrow we're backing the same horse that won yesterday. If you're looking for us to get cute and fade our own logic, you came to the wrong place. Atlanta rides again.

**Let's make it 4-1 over two days.**

author: Rico
